info.title: JanSetu Integrated Citizen Services Platform API
info.description: Grievance redressal (PS1), unified call centre (PS2), e-Office (PS3), service uptime (PS4) and benefit navigation (PS5). All simulated components are labelled as such.

get.description: Prometheus exposition format (scrape target for an external Prometheus, if configured).
Public labelled triage evaluation dataset (demo). Link is built from PUBLIC_BASE_URL / request host.

post.description: Runs the full triage pipeline and returns a structured, explainable result. Creates no ticket.

get.description: Public tracking by ticket ID: status and public updates only - no personal data or complaint text.

post.description: Creates a clearly-labelled SIMULATED inbound call with a scripted transcript (no telephony involved).

Manual record of an interaction (e.g. a call on a desk phone). Channels without a configured provider are
recorded as simulated.
Assisted-service mode: a person asks a human to call back. Lands in the agent queue (a real record).

get.description: Platform load trend from real persisted records (tickets + interactions per day) and a capacity-risk rule.
Complaint markers in the caller's scope + live field-team positions. Poll every few seconds.
Citizen view: own complaints with pins, plus approximate distance of the assigned officer when shared.
Location + live progress for one ticket (citizen owner or staff in scope).
Data-access request: returns the signed-in user's own records.
